in_marathi.name: Ashritha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashritha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashritha is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ashritha’ and ‘Shritha’. It means ‘peaceful seat’ or ‘that which provides a peaceful seat’. It is believed that the god Vishnu provides a peaceful seat to his devotees. This name is also associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who is the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and fortune.
